children.value: Every segment must return zero label bits. Ancillas are reset for reuse; an attempt runs all segments and finally measures every system wire in Z. The exported attempt circuits include initial resets, all access/uncomputation, label measurement/reset and final readout; their output is an accepted measured trial. The conditional state checked above describes the system immediately before that final readout. Whole-attempt acceptance is the product of state-dependent conditional probabilities. At eight segments, ideal acceptance is about

, requiring thousands of complete attempts for one accepted measured trial with 99% confidence. The ledger also records a capped retry budget for many accepted observable shots, charging the complete schedule each time.

It is not supplied by the postselection circuit. State/observable values come from ideal simulation; approximation errors exclude rotation synthesis, physical faults and finite-shot noise. This unamplified demonstration is not an efficiency comparison with product formulas.

children.value: circuit has 3 logical qubits, no ancillas and 224 arbitrary rotations before synthesis. Metadata counts gates/depth per shot and across the proposed shot count. Depth is circuit dependency layering; no physical scheduling model is applied. LCU and QSP have separate access, ancilla, measurement and retry ledgers. Their targets differ, so these counts are not an equal-task comparison.

Coefficient handling, classical readout/postprocessing wall time and physical initialization time are unmeasured. Synthesis, error correction, factories, physical qubits and runtime are unavailable. The frozen Grover surface-code baseline is unchanged.

Product-formula construction stops at 64 spins, 20,000 steps or 200,000 term exponentials; dense references stop at eight spins. LCU allows at most 256 explicit terms and 32 system qubits, with a 12-total-qubit statevector cap and a Taylor degree cap. QSP declares its own bounds. Indexed SELECT materialization is costly; parameterization does not imply affordable large-scale access. No remote run is used.
supplies labeled chapter outputs and optional live circuit controls. Static execution with
omits widget objects. For independent downloads, save the three Python modules below beside the notebook and install the
. Frozen phases are also included in the QSP module.

The text and circuit constructions are original. Exact Qiskit 2.6.2 source and Apache-2.0 license, and SciPy 1.18.1 source and BSD-3-Clause license, are recorded in the bibliography. Generated artifacts record parameters, package versions, source hashes, compilation settings, seeds and CPU backend. Matrix exponentiation is exclusively a bounded classical reference. Formal verification is not integrated.
